        "contents": "class APIService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Translate text from source language to target language\n   * @param {string} text - Text to translate\n   * @param {string} targetLang - Target language\n   * @param {string} model - Model to use for translation\n   * @param {string} sourceLang - Source language (optional)\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;Object&gt;} Translation result with content and usage\n   */\n  async translate(text, targetLang, model, sourceLang = null, signal = null) {\n    try {\n      let systemPrompt;\n\n      if (sourceLang &amp;&amp; sourceLang !== \"Detect Language\") {\n        systemPrompt = &#96;You are a professional translator specializing in ${sourceLang} to ${targetLang} translation.\n\nYour task:\n- Translate the user's text from ${sourceLang} into natural, fluent ${targetLang}\n- Preserve the original tone, style, and intent\n- Maintain any formatting (line breaks, bullet points, etc.)\n- Keep proper nouns, technical terms, and brand names unchanged unless they have standard translations\n- Do not add explanations, notes, or commentary\n- Output only the translated text&#96;;\n      } else {\n        systemPrompt = &#96;You are a professional translator specializing in ${targetLang}.\n\nYour task:\n- Translate the user's text into natural, fluent ${targetLang}\n- Preserve the original tone, style, and intent\n- Maintain any formatting (line breaks, bullet points, etc.)\n- Keep proper nouns, technical terms, and brand names unchanged unless they have standard translations\n- Do not add explanations, notes, or commentary\n- Output only the translated text&#96;;\n      }\n\n      const fetchOptions = {\n        method: \"POST\",\n        headers: this.getHeaders(),\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          model: model,\n          messages: [\n            { role: \"system\", content: systemPrompt },\n            { role: \"user\", content: text },\n          ],\n          temperature: 0.3, // Lower temperature for more consistent translations\n        }),\n      };\n\n      if (signal) {\n        fetchOptions.signal = signal;\n      }\n\n      const response = await fetch(&#96;${this.baseUrl}/chat/completions&#96;, fetchOptions);\n  }",

        "contents": "const SettingsDialogLanguagesTab = \n\n\n      &lt;div className=\"languages-section\"&gt;\n        &lt;h3 style={{ marginTop: 36, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}&gt;\n          &lt;Globe size={20} /&gt;\n          Custom Language\n        &lt;/h3&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"form-group\" style={{ marginTop: '12px' }}&gt;\n          &lt;Input\n            type=\"text\"\n            value={customLanguage}\n            onChange={(e) =&gt; onCustomLanguageChange(e.target.value)}\n            onBlur={(e) =&gt; {\n              const lang = e.target.value.trim();\n              if (lang &amp;&amp; !selectedLanguages.has(lang) &amp;&amp; !ALL_AVAILABLE_LANGUAGES.includes(lang)) {\n                const newSet = new Set(selectedLanguages);\n                newSet.add(lang);\n                onSelectedLanguagesChange(newSet);\n                // Auto-save: persist immediately\n                onSetting('available_languages', Array.from(newSet));\n              }\n            }}\n            onKeyDown={(e) =&gt; {\n              if (e.key === 'Enter') {\n                const lang = customLanguage.trim();\n                if (lang &amp;&amp; !selectedLanguages.has(lang) &amp;&amp; !ALL_AVAILABLE_LANGUAGES.includes(lang)) {\n                  const newSet = new Set(selectedLanguages);\n                  newSet.add(lang);\n                  onSelectedLanguagesChange(newSet);\n                  onCustomLanguageChange('');\n                  // Auto-save: persist immediately\n                  onSetting('available_languages', Array.from(newSet));\n                }\n              }\n            }}\n            placeholder=\"Enter custom language name and press Enter\"\n            style={{ width: '50%'}}\n          /&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n};\n\nexport default SettingsDialogLanguagesTab;",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./src/renderer/contexts/AppContext.js",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 27
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 353,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "export const AppProvider = \n\n\n  // Rewrite text\n  const rewrite = async (text, style, model, signal = null) =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      const result = await apiService.rewrite(text, style, model, signal);\n\n      // Update last used model\n      // Do not overwrite last_used_model here; it is persisted via user selection in the header.\n\n      // Update total cost if applicable\n      if (result.usage) {\n        const { prompt_tokens = 0, completion_tokens = 0 } = result.usage;\n        const calculatedCost = computeCostFromUsage(\n          model,\n          prompt_tokens,\n          completion_tokens,\n        );\n        const newTotalCost = (settings.total_cost || 0) + calculatedCost;\n        setSetting(\"total_cost\", newTotalCost);\n        result.calculated_cost = calculatedCost;\n        result.total_cost = newTotalCost;\n      }\n\n      result.model_used = result.model || model;\n\n      writeLastApiResult({\n        type: \"rewrite\",\n        model: result.model_used,\n        usage: result.usage,\n        calculated_cost: result.calculated_cost,\n        total_cost: result.total_cost,\n        raw: result,\n      });\n\n      return result;\n    } catch (err) {\n      if (err.name === \"AbortError\") throw err;\n      setError(\"Rewrite failed\");\n      console.error(err);\n      return { error: err.message };\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Fetch models from API (called when Settings opens)\n;",
        "signatures": {
          "ranges": [
            {
              "startPosition": {
                "line": 28,
                "column": 1
              },
              "endPosition": {

        "contents": "export const AppProvider = \n\n\n  // Update a single setting\n  const setSetting = (key, value) =&gt; {\n    configManager.set(key, value);\n    // Ensure we get a fresh copy of all settings to trigger React re-render\n    // Use JSON parse/stringify to ensure deep copy and new reference\n    const allSettings = configManager.getAll();\n    const updatedSettings = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(allSettings));\n    setSettings(updatedSettings);\n\n    // Update the API service base URL when settings change\n    if (key === \"api_url\") {\n      apiService.setBaseUrl(value || \"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1\");\n    }\n    \n    // Update languages state when available_languages changes\n    if (key === \"available_languages\") {\n      // Create a new array reference to ensure React detects the change\n      const newLanguages = Array.isArray(value) ? [...value] : (value || []);\n      setLanguages(newLanguages);\n    }\n    \n    // Update availableModels state when available_models changes\n    if (key === \"available_models\") {\n      // Create a new array reference to ensure React detects the change\n      const newModels = Array.isArray(value) ? [...value] : (value || []);\n      setAvailableModels(newModels);\n    }\n    \n    // Notify other windows about the settings update (for all settings)\n    if (window.electronAPI &amp;&amp; window.electronAPI.notifySettingsUpdated) {\n      window.electronAPI.notifySettingsUpdated();\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Translate text\n  const translate = async (text, targetLang, model, sourceLang = null, signal = null)\n;\n;",

        "contents": "/* Fluent UI Integration - Custom Styles for Electron App */\n/* \n * Fluent UI React provides most component styling (buttons, inputs, tabs, etc.)\n * This file contains only:\n * - Essential Electron-specific styles (window dragging, etc.)\n * - Custom modal/dialog positioning (for draggable SettingsDialog)\n * - Layout utilities not provided by Fluent UI\n * - Legacy styles for components not yet fully migrated\n */\n\n body {\n    margin: 0;\n    padding: 0;\n    font-family:\n        \"Segoe UI Variable\",\n        \"Segoe UI\",\n        system-ui,\n        -apple-system,\n        sans-serif;\n    user-select: none;\n    overflow: hidden; /* Prevent body scroll */\n}\n\n/* Enable text selection for text content */\ntextarea,\n.panel-title,\n.stats,\n.tab-content,\n.modal-body,\np,\nspan {\n    user-select: text;\n    -webkit-user-select: text;\n    -moz-user-select: text;\n    -ms-user-select: text;\n}\n\n/* Keep buttons non-selectable */\nbutton,\n.provider-header,\n.provider-header-modern {\n    user-select: none !important;\n    -webkit-user-select: none !important;\n}\n\ninput,\ntextarea,\nselect,\nbutton {\n    font-family: inherit;\n}\n\n#root {\n    height: 100vh;\n    display: flex;\n    flex-direction: column;\n}\n\n/* Enable text selection for labels and text content */\nlabel,\n.lang-checkbox,\n.text-area,\n.panel-title,\n.stats,\n.form-group label,\n.tab-content,\n.modal-body,\np,\nspan {\n    user-select: text;\n    -webkit-user-select: text;\n    -moz-user-select: text;\n    -ms-user-select: text;\n}\n\n/* Keep checkboxes, radio buttons, and buttons non-selectable */\ninput[type=\"checkbox\"],\ninput[type=\"radio\"],\nbutton,\n.btn,\n.provider-header,\n.provider-header-modern {\n    user-select: none !important;\n    -webkit-user-select: none !important;\n}\n\ninput,\ntextarea,\nselect,\nbutton {\n    font-family: inherit;\n}\n\n#root {\n    height: 100vh;\n    display: flex;\n    flex-direction: column;\n}\n\n/* Sidebar layout - app container */\n.app-container {\n    display: flex;",

Summary of changes:

## Changes Made

### 1. **Settings > Behavior & Appearance tab** (`SettingsDialogGeneralTab.js`)
- Added a dropdown for **"Auto-translate on paste"** in the Behavior section.
- Options:
  - **On** — Start translation when pasting text (default)
  - **Off** — Only paste, do not translate
- Added a short description under the dropdown.

### 2. **App logic** (`App.js`)
- **`handlePasteEvent`** — Runs translation on paste only when `settings.auto_translate_on_paste !== false`.
- **`pasteToInput`** — Runs translation after using the paste button only when the same setting is enabled.

### 3. **Default config** (`config_default.json`)
- Added `auto_translate_on_paste: true` so new installs default to the current behavior.

## Behavior

- **On (default)**: Pasting (Ctrl+V or paste button) starts translation immediately.
- **Off**: Pasting inserts text only; translation runs when the user presses the Translate button or Ctrl+Enter.

Existing users without this setting in their config get the default (On).

The `MODEL_PRICING` table is **hardcoded** at the top of `AppContext.js` with only 4 models. However, it's **not actually used** for the cost calculation we saw.

The real pricing data comes from:

1. **`allModels` state** — populated by `apiService.getModels()` when Settings opens
2. **`settings.cached_models`** — optional backup

The `computeCostFromUsage` function looks up the model's `pricing` field from the API response:

```javascript
const computeCostFromUsage = (modelId, promptTokens, completionTokens) => {
  const pricing =
    allModels.find((m) => m.id === modelId)?.pricing ||
    settings.cached_models?.find((m) => m.id === modelId)?.pricing;
  // ...
};
```

The hardcoded `MODEL_PRICING` and the old `calculateCost` function appear to be unused legacy code. The actual cost comes from:
- **API's `usage.cost`** (preferred, from OpenRouter)
- Or the model's `pricing` object from the models list

The models endpoint returns each model with pricing data like:
```json
{
  "id": "alibaba/tongyi-deepresearch-30b-a3b",
  "pricing": {
    "prompt": 0.00009,
    "completion": 0.00036
  }
}
```
